name: Boon Of Fortune S Favor
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Saving Throw Reroll
features.description: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until the start of your next turn.
